## Marketing page (datadoghq.com/product/llm-observability/)
Headline: "Ship AI agents faster, with confidence"
Desc: "Evaluate, improve, and trace your AI agents with offline experimentation and
production observability in one platform." "from prototype to production faster in one platform."

Observes: token usage, latency, error rates/failures, cost, quality scores + drift, response
accuracy, user session correlation. End-to-end LLM tracing ("trace every agent step"),
datasets from production traces, experiments (prompts/models/configs), offline + online evals,
human review/annotation, production monitoring + alerting, sensitive data scanning + redaction,
root cause analysis across full application stack, execution graph inspection, tool decision
tracking, golden dataset versioning, custom + built-in evaluators, hallucination detection,
prompt injection catching, PII exposure detection, RBAC.

Integrations:
- LLM providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Vertex AI, Bedrock, LiteLLM
- Frameworks: LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic, Strands Agents
- Infra: Vercel, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes
- SDKs: Python, Node.js, Java, OpenTelemetry, HTTP API

Customers:
- Twine (AI cybersecurity): "Datadog LLM Observability gives us complete visibility into our
  agents' reasoning so we can reduce cost, improve reliability, and ship with confidence."
- Fintool (AI financial copilot): "We've improved response accuracy and reduced latency,
  ensuring faster, more reliable insights for our customers."
- AppFolio (AI Property Manager): "Helped us ensure high model performance and quality, and
  allowed us to expand functionality quickly and safely."
- Page metrics (attribution unclear): "400% faster MTTR", "40% lower token usage per task",
  "15% faster deployment"

## Docs page (docs.datadoghq.com/llm_observability/)
Definition: "Monitor, troubleshoot, and evaluate your LLM-powered applications, such as
chatbots. You can investigate the root cause of issues, monitor operational performance, and
evaluate the quality, privacy, and safety of your LLM applications."
Each request = a trace. Spans: individual LLM inference (tokens, error info, latency);
predetermined workflow; dynamic workflow executed by an LLM agent; span per agent choice / step.
Metrics: cost, latency, performance, token usage trends; error detection + root cause; privacy
issues. Quality/safety: prompt injection detection, sensitive data scanning + redaction,
"automated hierarchical topic clustering" (Patterns), outlier detection across span name /
workflow type / patterns topics.
Auto-instrumented (Python SDK, no code mods): OpenAI, LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic.
